{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "focal",
      "toKey": "n-1wzbnxb",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The focal event (low-pressure indication at P-R triggering alarm AL-44) is the direct cause of RHOB reporting an 'air-low' indication and requesting Utilities attendance. The pressure drop caused the condition that necessitated the report.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["incident-description", "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the pressure had not dropped below 4.5 bar, AL-44 would not have triggered and RHOB would not have reported an 'air-low' indication.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; this is a direct causal link between event occurrence and notification.",
      "evidenceGap": "The exact timing of the report relative to alarm trigger (10:00 vs 10:03) remains slightly ambiguous but does not break causality."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-ax2alr",
      "toKey": "n-6lcr51",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pressure drop (condition) occurred while no line opening was authorized. The lack of authorization is a condition that existed at the time, not caused by the pressure drop itself.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a line opening had been authorized, the pressure drop might have been mitigated or managed differently.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; authorization status is independent of the physical event but relevant to response capability.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence shows why no line opening was requested/authorized at that moment."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1wzbnxb",
      "toKey": "n-6748yt",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "RHOB's report of an 'air-low' indication and request for attendance (event) caused Utilities to acknowledge the issue at ~10:02 AM and pause work.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If RHOB had not reported the issue, Utilities would not have acknowledged it at 10:02 AM.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; communication flow is linear here.",
      "evidenceGap": "The exact mechanism of acknowledgment (phone call, radio, etc.) is unknown but irrelevant to causality."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1675uru",
      "toKey": "n-1wzbnxb",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The normal operation of the Utilities air gallery serving RHOB (condition) enabled the possibility that a pressure drop at P-R would be detected as an 'air-low' indication and reported.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the air gallery did not serve RHOB, a pressure drop there would not have affected RHOB operations.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; service routing is established by design.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence of recent changes to service routing that might alter this relationship."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-gybvj2",
      "toKey": "n-1wzbnxb",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The alarm logic (AL-44 activates below 4.5 bar) enabled the detection and reporting of an 'air-low' condition when pressure dropped.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the alarm threshold were higher or lower, the timing of detection and reporting would differ.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; alarm logic is fixed by design.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence that AL-44 was misconfigured at this time."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-q7dwrs",
      "toKey": "n-1wzbnxb",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The blank work package field execution record (condition) enabled the possibility that no formal boundary release or line-opening authorization existed, contributing to the unmitigated impact of the pressure drop.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the work package had been properly executed and signed, a line opening might have been authorized or documented.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; blank field is clear evidence of incomplete documentation.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence that this was intentional omission vs. oversight."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1q7qtf5",
      "toKey": "n-6lcr51",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The unsigned maintenance acceptance signature (condition) enabled the state where no line opening was authorized at acknowledgment time.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the signature had been obtained, a line opening might have been authorized.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; unsigned form means no acceptance yet.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence of why signature was pending at shift start."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-3ykejq",
      "toKey": "n-1wzbnxb",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The daily briefing topic line mentioning '1SC dryer work and RHOB service coordination' without valve-by-valve content enabled the possibility that crew awareness of specific hazards or procedures was incomplete.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the briefing had included valve states, crew might have been better prepared for potential interruptions.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; vague briefings are common but can contribute to risk.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence of whether this was standard practice or an oversight."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1b1mn9d",
      "toKey": "n-6lcr51",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The unknown status of whether the crew saw recent changes or used a different version of the equipment-location sheet enabled uncertainty about their situational awareness, which may have contributed to not requesting a line opening.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the crew had seen recent changes, they might have requested a line opening.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; this is speculative without evidence of what version was used.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need to determine if equipment-location sheets were updated and whether crews received them."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-5fesl6",
      "toKey": "n-1wzbnxb",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The lack of documented confirmation regarding root cause assessment or response steps enabled the possibility that crew understanding of the alarm and appropriate actions was incomplete.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["claim-1abjb6"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If such documentation existed, it might have guided proper response.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; absence of record does not prove non-existence in practice.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need to verify if informal communication occurred despite lack of records."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1qpkyz6",
      "toKey": "n-6lcr51",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The shift log recording 'boundary preparation in progress' without identifying valve states enabled uncertainty about the physical state of the system, which may have contributed to not requesting a line opening.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If valve states were logged, they might have informed decision-making.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; logs are often incomplete by design.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence of whether this was standard practice or an oversight."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1ry5vzu",
      "toKey": "n-6lcr51",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The pressure and alarm extract supplying sampled values rather than a continuous waveform enabled uncertainty about the exact timing of the pressure drop, which may have affected response decisions.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If continuous data were available, the exact timing might have been clearer.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; sampling is standard for some systems.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence that this limitation contributed to the incident."
    }
  ],"decision":{"summary":"The causal chain begins with a pressure drop at P-R (n-ax2alr) triggering alarm AL-44, which caused RHOB to report an 'air-low' indication and request Utilities attendance (n-1wzbnxb). This led to Utilities acknowledging the issue and pausing work (n-6748yt). Contributing conditions include a blank work package field execution record (n-q7dwrs), unsigned maintenance acceptance signature (n-1q7qtf5), lack of documented confirmation regarding root cause assessment or response steps (n-5fesl6), vague daily briefing content (n-3ykejq), and unknown status of whether the crew saw recent changes or used a different version of equipment-location sheet (n-1b1mn9d). The focal event was not caused by its own preconditions but rather by an external pressure drop. Evidence gaps remain regarding why no line opening was authorized, what specific valve states existed at the time, and whether informal communication occurred despite lack of records.","evidenceUsed":["incident-description","24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1","eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078","da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1","b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1","fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],"unknowns":["Why no line opening was authorized at acknowledgment time.","What specific valve states existed during the pressure drop.","Whether informal communication occurred despite lack of records."],"alternatives":[], "confidence":0.82},"evidenceRequests":[
    "requestId-req-001",
    "claimRef:eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"
  ]}
